qubo_kind: diagnostic upper-triangular random QUBO, not trained FM or material objective
initialization: product of W states via ideal initial_state vector injection; no preparation gate synthesis
mixer_topology: ring per group; increasing neighboring edges then closing edge; 2-choice single undirected edge; singleton no edge
mixer_evolution: ordered per-edge RXX(beta) RYY(beta), exp[-i beta(XX+YY)/2] per edge; not exact exp of full ring sum
checks: small-case penalties on all basis states
resource_scope: full 2**N statevector; reference restricted to feasible basis only and used for validation
